claims: Runs displays all 186 persisted DeepEval example results with failures first
A failed example drills into input, output, reference, evaluator reason, tokens, cost, and latency
The example opens its canonical OTLP execution trace and span waterfall
Evals exposes all 27 evaluator definitions and complete setup
Fragmented multi-call examples aggregate under their logical execution without choosing an unrelated root
isolation: Real local Chorus server over a local-source golden DeepEval corpus; no production DynamoDB reads, no SMS delivery, and no customer identity or secrets in the recording.
limitations: Production-trace promotion into a dataset is not exercised in this demo; this PR establishes the DeepEval dataset and experiment path first.
